I replied to Dana in a thread on their #north-team message: the hub replacement in Zoom Room B is IT ticket **#4092**.

The number comes from Ilse, who posted it in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. Dana is a member of that channel, so they could see it themselves. I passed on Ilse's warning too: don't unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

Dana's earlier DM guessed the ticket would be "OPS-5546 next year." I left that out of the channel reply because they asked me to keep it private, and it was only a guess anyway.
